_readme: The listen-address vocabulary the hub and the browser both spell. The hub owns the address model (internal/hub/listenset) and the panel that edits it owns the rows, so three values crossed the language boundary by hand: the wildcard host token, the cap on how many extra addresses a hub may store, and the three words the hub uses to say WHY an address is served. Each was written twice, and the second copy had already drifted -- the panel offered a ninth row that only the hub refused. Codegen replaces the copies without creating an import edge: the generated constants depend on no internal package of either program.

addressSources.extra: an address the extra_listen_addresses setting adds
addressSources.merged: one socket serving both, because this address covers what -listen gives
